title: Clear Specific Filters
body:
Is there a way to clear specific facet filters in instant search. I would like to know the implementation of that in react native.

Or else after clear refinements how do I reset to default refinements applied initially. Because the clearRefinement actually clears default refinements applied to a facet field.

comments.body:
Hey Raman, you can use `transformItems` to ignore the refinements you set initially in [connectCurrentRefinements](https://community.algolia.com/react-instantsearch/connectors/connectCurrentRefinements.html). Can you give some code of what you tried already? 

P.S. this repository is for the Vanilla InstantSearch.js, https://github.com/algolia/react-instantsearch is for React and React Native :), please follow up there if there's more questions!

@Haroenv I apologize again for asking in wrong window. Will post the same in react instantsearch repo.

I have a refinement as below which has defaultRefinement set
```jsx
<RefinementList attribute="specialities" defaultRefinement={['foo', 'bar']} />
```

The clearRefinement method as implemented below
```jsx
const ClearAllRefinements = ({refine, items}) => {
  return  <TouchableHighlight underlayColor="#eef0f0" onPress={() => refine(items)} style={{height: 50, flex: 1, flexDirection: 'column', justifyContent: 'center', alignItems: 'center'}}>
            <Text>Clear</Text>
          </TouchableHighlight>
};

const ConnectedClearAllRefinements = connectCurrentRefinements(ClearAllRefinements);

<ConnectedClearAllRefinements />
```
clears all filters including the defaultRefinements. I don't want that defaultRefinement to be cleared off.

Is there any option parameter which I can pass to `<ConnectedClearAllRefinements />` to ignore that was my query.
Yes, you can use `transformItems` to filter out `specialities`
